body: Gated simplification: delete the legacy Sense->Sharpen path (classify_sense_sharpen_inner + its ~300-line inline header cascade, wire_sense/set_sense, the char-cnn/tiered/transformer ModelType loaders, and models/char-cnn-v7|tiered-v1|sibling-context). NOT dead code -- it is the live path for --model-type char-cnn|tiered|transformer + a wired Sense model; the default (m2v8m-s43) and v19 are both multi-branch and do NOT use it. Removal reverses the settled 'Original Sense implementation remains in code as an alternative' decision, so it needs a choice record + card-0019-scenario-5 no-regression gold run, NOT a refactor. Surface: ~700 lines in classify_sense_sharpen_inner, 29 non-test loader refs, 14 refs in tests.rs + 9 in main.rs. BLOCKED ON t-0001080618 (public-release wants to ADD download/restore for exactly these legacy models -- settle that direction first). Hazard meanwhile: its inline header cascade is a DIVERGENT duplicate of apply_header_sharpen (thresholds 0.85/0.5 vs 0.95/0.85), so audit edits land only on the multi-branch copies. Surfaced in spec 2026-06-25-sharpen-stage-audit ac-0.

ac-1 url-cluster fix: 5 attention breaks (link_id x2, episode_url_id, link_description, remove_compare_link) where a 'link'/'url' header_hint promotes non-url values to technology.internet.url. The validator-corroboration guard CANNOT do this: the url universal validator rejects genuine urls too (href, gold=url, passes ~0% -- the protocol-relative // gap, task t-00007f4d). Fix: extend url_bare_number_veto to also demote url->alphanumeric_id/text when values are non-url-shaped (no '://'), independent of the validator; OR fix the url validator // gap first then the scoped guard can include url. Gold no-regression + corpus-honest. Evidence: output/sharpen-audit/ac1_measurement.md.

ac-1 utc-cluster fix: 4 attention breaks (utc_offset x4, gold=decimal) where 'utc offset' header_hint promotes millisecond-integer columns (28800000.0) to datetime.offset.utc. Validator guard can't gate (utc validator rejects ms-integers AND a gold=utc sibling at ~0%). Fix: dedicated utc_offset bare-number/ms demotion (ms-integers -> decimal_number). NOTE the 5th utc_offset (sha e2695df2e762, gold=offset.utc) has the SAME ms encoding as the 4 gold=decimal ones -> ac-3 gold inconsistency to resolve. Evidence: output/sharpen-audit/ac1_measurement.md.

ac-1 ordinal + alphanumeric_id clusters: (a) Grade/GlobalRank/TldRank/Region Rank -- deprecated header_hint 'rank'/'grade' arm promotes plain numerics to discrete.ordinal (no/loose validator); tighten the arm or value-gate ordinal to small bounded rank sets. (b) ipni_id x2, coord_id -- alphanumeric_id validator rejects digit+separator ids (69732-1, 15_77227420) so the profile validation veto hard-rejects to unknown; widen the alphanumeric_id validator OR keep alphanumeric_id on veto rather than demote-to-unknown. Both gold-gated. Evidence: output/sharpen-audit/ac1_measurement.md.

SCOPE EXPANDED + UNBLOCKED (author 2026-06-25). README declares Early Release (breaking changes to taxonomy/CLI/APIs/model formats expected between releases), so the t-0001080618 blocker is OBVIATED: DELETE the abandoned model paths rather than add download/restore. Comprehensive dead-architecture removal: (1) LEGACY SENSE PATH (as above). (2) FUSION PATH: classify_fusion + fusion_cardinality_gate (mod.rs ~2300) + with_fusion/has_fusion + load_fusion_classifier + fusion_manifest auto-detect (value-fusion abandoned per CLAUDE.md). (3) MODEL-TYPE LOADERS: drop ModelType::{CharCnn,Tiered,Transformer} + loaders + legacy model dirs models/{char-cnn-v7,tiered-v1,sibling-context}. (4) CATEGORICAL-SENTINEL COLLAPSE (behaviour-neutral): once fusion is gone the only non-default consumer of representation.discrete.categorical (fusion_cardinality_gate) is dead, so the ~13 Sharpen producer sites (feature_sharpen F6, header_sharpen arms, value_sharpen R32/schema_fail_demotion/select_fallback) emit representation.text.word DIRECTLY, then delete enum_reframe_residual + CATEGORICAL_LABEL sentinel. Behaviour-equivalent on multi-branch (categorical->word either way; both already generic-residual) so MUST be 0 gold delta. GATING: gold no-regression + green CI; do fusion removal BEFORE the categorical collapse. Evidence: 2026-06-25 guard-ablation finding (enum_reframe -47 proves the reframe is load-bearing UNTIL producers are rewired).
